title: Christmas daytimes at Beamish Museum
summary: Open daily 10am to 4pm from 21 November to 24 December and again 27 to 31 December; closed 25 and 26 December. No timeslot needed for daytime visits.

title: Christmas Evenings at Beamish Museum
summary: 5pm to 9.30pm on 3, 4, 10, 11, 17 and 18 December. Pre-book online; tickets cannot be bought at the museum and Unlimited Passes are not valid.

title: Quiet Santa Sessions at Beamish
summary: Sensory-friendly grotto on 19, 20 and 23 December, GBP 10 per person taking part. Pre-booking required.

title: Durham Christmas lights switch-on
summary: Sunday 29 November, 5pm to 6.15pm, Durham Market Place. Free, with live music and street performers.

title: Durham Christmas Festival
summary: 4 to 6 December in Durham Market Place.

title: Advent Procession at Durham Cathedral
summary: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November at 6pm. No ticket needed; arrive 15 minutes early.

title: Big Christmas Sing-A-Long with Aled Jones and Alexander Armstrong
The Snowman with live orchestra at Durham Cathedral
Britten's Ceremony of Carols at Durham Cathedral
Christmas at Locomotion, Shildon
summary: Runs 26 November to 3 January, with a Christmas Market on 28 and 29 November.

title: Festive Artisan Market at Dalton Park
Newcastle Christmas Market
summary: 19 November to 23 December on Grey Street, Grainger Street, around the Monument and on Nelson Street, plus a Christmas Village at Old Eldon Square.

title: Ice rink at the Centre for Life
Pre-Raphaelites: Art and Poetry at the Laing
summary: At the Laing Art Gallery, Newcastle, from 17 October 2026 to 13 February 2027.

title: Winter Lights at Alnwick Garden
summary: Light trail through the Garden and Lilidorei, 20 November to 3 January.

title: Christmas Fair Weekend at Alnwick Garden
summary: Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November, free entry.

title: Meet Father Christmas at Lilidorei
summary: 20 November to 24 December, daytime and evening slots, each with a private meeting and a gift.

title: Kielder Winter Wonderland
summary: Runs on selected dates through December; check the website for the current calendar.
